_comment: Free-tier LLM providers with an OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions endpoint (from https://github.com/mnfst/awesome-free-llm-apis). Model names change: run `tools/free_llm_reader.py models --provider NAME` once a key is set and copy a current vision model id here. Keys are read from environment variables, loaded from the git-ignored file .env.free-llms.

gemini.privacy: Free-tier prompts may be used by Google to improve its products.

mistral.privacy: Free-mode prompts may be used to train Mistral models unless you opt out.

cloudflare.privacy: Cloudflare Workers AI free allowance (10,000 neurons a day).

kilo.privacy: No key; shared free pool of third-party models, 200 requests an hour.
